name: Hoop Shot 3D
description: Swipe up to shoot hoops on a 3D court: real bounces off the rim, swishes, streaks and a moving hoop.
prompt: A 3D basketball shooting game with three.js: swipe up to throw, ball physics that bounce off the rim and backboard, a wooden court and crowd lights, 60 seconds, extra points for swishes and streaks, and the hoop starts moving after 10 points.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Desliza hacia arriba para encestar en una pista 3D: rebotes reales en el aro, canastas limpias, rachas y una canasta que se mueve.
